qa.q: Are there limits on adding a visit?

A free 5-level surf game on the Venice Pier loop. Paddle out past stingrays and a fisherman's stray harpoons, grab food rafts, then ride the wave home.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play?
qa.a: No, play with or without an account. If you aren't a member yet, today's points are held on your phone and saved if you join the same day.

qa.q: How do I play Ride the Nalu?
qa.a: Drag left and right to steer. While paddling out, tap DUCK DIVE under each breaking wave. Riding in, stay on the clean face, tap JUMP to launch off the lip, then use TRICK in the air and land it.
In the air, tap TRICK or swipe: sideways is a 360, down is a grab, up is a flip. Finish it before you land, or it's a small bail.

Food rafts score: Island Tacos +100, Mimosa +120, Jungle Fries +120, Smash-N-Stack +150, Coconut Shrimp +150. Duck-diving a wave is +100 and a barrel exit +200. Chaining 4 in a row is ×2, and a hit resets it.

qa.q: What hurts me in the game?
qa.a: Touching white foam costs ½ heart and 100 points. Stingrays and harpoons cost a heart, and landing mid-trick is −150. You have 5 hearts, lost in halves. A hit is a mild wipeout.
5 levels. Level 1 is about 2 minutes, and later levels have a shorter paddle-out. Ride all 5 for a big finish bonus.

qa.q: How do game points become rewards points?
qa.a: Every 100 score is 1 Nalu Vida Rewards point, up to 50 game points a day.
As often as you like, for free. Only the rewards points are capped, at 50 a day.

qa.q: Does the game win me prizes or discounts?
qa.a: No. The game gives no prizes, codes or discounts. It earns rewards points (up to 50 a day).

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: There's a weekly board for bragging rights only. It resets every Monday.

qa.q: Is there a weekly champion prize?
qa.a: No prize is listed. The weekly board is for bragging rights only.

qa.q: Do cheats count on the leaderboard?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts don't count.

qa.q: Can I change the game's graphics, weather or music?
qa.a: Yes. In Settings, pick Graphics (Auto to Ultra), Weather, Time of day and a Song (Cheat Code or Xtreme Rich Person). There's also a 3D graphics (beta) switch.

qa.q: Can I play with a game controller?
qa.a: Yes, controllers work in most browsers. Pair it, press a button, then use the stick, D-pad and A. The game's help sheet lists the buttons.

qa.q: Is there a hidden bonus in the game?
qa.a: Yes. A billboard buoy floats by the pier once a run. Ride through it for a bonus (+500 in the game's points list).

qa.q: Is the game safe for kids?
qa.a: The game has no weapons or boss fights. Bumping into things is a mild wipeout and you pop back up. I don't have separate kid-mode rules.

qa.q: Can I order from my table?
qa.a: Yes. Choose Patio, Bar, Dining room or Rooftop, add your items and send the order. If you scanned a table code, your spot is already picked.

qa.q: How do I pick my table?
qa.a: Tap your area. For the patio, dining room or rooftop, you can also tap your table number (1–20). The bar needs no number.
Pay your server or bartender like normal. The app doesn't take payment.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: Use the 🌐 language button to switch. The default list includes English, Español, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 한국어, Tagalog, Tiếng Việt, Հայերեն, فارسی, 日本語, ไทย and Русский. Names of the restaurant and game stay in English.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my home screen?
qa.a: On iPhone, tap Share then Add to Home Screen. On Android, open the browser menu and tap Add to Home screen or Install. The app also offers steps for this.
Apple and Google Wallet aren't available yet. You can use the digital rewards card in the app.

qa.q: What data does the app collect?
qa.a: Each time you open the app (at most every 10 minutes) it records the time, a short device summary, whether you opened it from your Home Screen, a random phone ID and your member ID if you joined. Location is recorded only if you've already turned it on for the app. It's never sold or used for ads.
Yes. Turn location off for this site or app in your phone's Settings. The app never asks for location just for this.

qa.q: Can I cheat the one-prize-per-day rule with another phone?
qa.a: No. The limits are checked by our server, so a second phone, cleared browser or screenshot doesn't get around them.
Yes. Nalu Vida can change the program, point values or rewards with notice in the app. Points already earned stay in your balance unless the program ends.
